overview.title: Analyst Registry

profileCreate.intro: A new profile version starts as a draft. It must be approved before workflows can use it.

profileVersion.heading: {{profileId}} version {{version}}

workflowCreate.title: Define a workflow version

selfApproval: You created this profile version. You are approving your own work.

approve.title: Approve profile version
approve.body: Approve {{profileId}} version {{version}} (image {{imageDigest}}, model {{modelDigest}})? Approved versions never change.

retire.title: Retire profile version
retire.body: Retire {{profileId}} version {{version}} (image {{imageDigest}}, model {{modelDigest}})? A retired version cannot be used in new workflow versions. Existing workflow versions and analysis runs keep it.

default.title: Make workflow version the default
default.body: Make {{workflowId}} version {{version}} the default workflow? The current default is {{current}}. Only analysis runs created afterwards use it; existing runs keep their snapshot.
default.noDefaultNote: No default workflow exists yet. Once this version is the default, new analysis runs can be created.
